verdict.rationale: Rollbar publishes a RESTful API reference at docs.rollbar.com/reference, with per-endpoint example requests such as listing error/critical items in production and paginating active items. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, which limits machine-driven exploration. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent corroboration of the reference experience
